title: Family wedding planning

memories.content: Planning younger sister's wedding in Guntur
Prefers updates as a short checklist

topics.ask: My sister's wedding is in February 2027 in Guntur, budget ₹12 lakh. Make a plan.
topics.answer: Split the ₹12 lakh: venue and decoration ₹3 lakh, food ₹3.5 lakh, clothes and jewellery ₹2.5 lakh, photography ₹80,000, invitations and return gifts ₹60,000, priest, music and rituals ₹50,000, travel and stay for guests ₹60,000, buffer ₹50,000. Book the venue and caterer first (by November), photographer by December, invitations printed in early January.

Take the ₹40,000 from the buffer only if the venue includes decoration; otherwise ask for a lower quote or a weekday rate. If you use the buffer, it drops to ₹10,000, so keep return gifts at ₹50,000 instead of ₹60,000 to rebuild it.

topics.ask: Give me the checklist for November.
topics.answer: November: book venue (pay advance), book caterer and finalise menu tasting date, shortlist two photographers, finalise guest list count, start clothes shopping for the main ceremony.
